findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler and only contains `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, so MetricAlertDetectorHandler remains abstract. MetricAlertFire still sets `detector_handler = MetricAlertDetectorHandler`, and Detector.detector_handler calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`. Any detector whose type resolves to metric_alert_fire will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` instead of processing. Implement the abstract methods or remove/avoid registering this handler until they exist.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses the wrong group key in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe
findings.body: `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` is called with group key `'val1'`, so the expected IssueOccurrence fingerprint is built as `[f'{detector.id}:val1']`. The assertion below calls `evaluate_group_key_value` with `expected_result.group_key`, which is `'group_key'`; the production hook therefore builds the actual occurrence with fingerprint `[f'{detector.id}:group_key']`. IssueOccurrence equality includes the fingerprint, so this assertion fails. Build the expected occurrence using `'group_key'` (or `expected_result.group_key`).

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The evaluate docstring still says it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult, but the method signature and implementation now return a dict keyed by DetectorGroupKey. This is the contract subclasses implement, so the stale text misdocuments the new API.
